text:
Careers
01
True Partners
True partners create relationships that go beyond monotonous online meetings. Our employees are ready to travel to clients' offices and work face-to-face to ensure we are heading in the same direction. High-intensity workshops and product explorations lead to exceptional solutions that may have never surfaced otherwise.
03
Cross-Office Collaboration
Creativity is a group process, and when people with unique skill sets and viewpoints collaborate, creativity thrives. Moreover, learning from members with different motives and strengths broadens everyone’s perspective and boosts problem-solving skills. We encourage our employees to work side-by-side with their cross-office teammates to develop unique and innovative solutions and further strengthen our relationship.
05
Modern Environment
We ensure our employees' well-being by creating an inspirational atmosphere and pleasant environment. Modern office and high-quality equipment provide our team with the tools they need to perform their jobs efficiently. On top of that, our employees have the latest software available to showcase their skills and acquire new ones.
02
A Culture of Learning
We love seeing our team grow both professionally and personally. Investing in employee development is more than just upskilling employees with technical skills. Focusing on skills like effective communication, adaptability, and teamwork helps prime employees for whatever changes come their way. We appreciate our team's eagerness to learn and grow by supporting them with a personal, educational budget.
04
Pet-friendly workplace
A friendly and welcoming company culture speaks a lot about who we are. Our primary consideration is to embrace a healthy lifestyle. Pets create a cozy and comfortable environment that makes our employees counterbalance work and personal life. The positive mentality that our employees develop by being around the pets in the office significantly improves their general performance.
06
Flexibility
In Akeo, it's all about flexibility - whether flexible working hours or workplace. We value a healthy work-life balance and care for our team's well-being. Our employees have the freedom to choose when and where they'll work, boosting creativity and efficiency to another level. Flexibility in work additionally increases the autonomy of each individual, making them feel trusted and allowing them to work the way that is most conducive to their own best performance.

# Starburst Innovative Aviation And Space Accelerator

Mission-driven, Starburst’s goal is to advance technology in the Aerospace sector. They support innovation by leveraging the expertise and novel ideation found in large and small businesses, government organizations, and academic institutions. Over the last decade, Starburst has proven that this future-focused, diverse ecosystem of collaborators can bring their partners to the forefront of innovation. Connecting visionary founders in their Aerospace accelerators to their extensive network of global aviation, space, and defense leaders–fostered in their parallel consulting practice–has changed the industry.

‍

The main focus of this project was developing an extensive design construction system. A Series of iterations brought us to the smallest common denominator used for building endless possibilities of formations. The principle of stacking our base component was applied to the master brand logotype and logotypes for Starburst's accelerator programs. A comprehensive design system covered standards for using typography, color palette, and imagery. Apart from the design system, our task was creating collaterals for printed and digital elements.

# Petonline Fine Italian Pet Grooming Products

As an integral part of the world-famous Iv San Bernard ACADEMY, PetOnline is an international store that offers premium products to pet groomers, owners, breeders, and veterinarians. With their team of international champions and specialists from various areas of hairdressing and "master" design techniques, they educate with an emphasis on correct care techniques in dermatology, derma cosmetology, and ozone therapy. They advise choosing suitable cosmetics, tools, and equipment for pets and provide various training in the professional care of small animals.

‍

Our goal was to create a website that would quickly identify customers' needs, record their pets' medical cards and offer high-quality products ideal for their pets. We took special care of our business customers by providing them with an extensive dashboard that tracks their spending and benefits over time. We extended their brand with a new set of friendly illustrations and distinctive typography that can be very well utilized both on the web and in print. We also dedicated a lot of effort to developing their brand style manual and social media templates.
